## Bio

PhD-level researcher working in satellite precipitation and optical remote
sensing. Background includes work with PERSIANN and atmospheric river
research. This site collects reproducible workflows, code walkthroughs, and
notes from ongoing projects.

## Research interests

- Satellite precipitation retrieval and validation
- Optical / hyperspectral remote sensing (e.g., EMIT, PRISMA)
- Cloud-native geospatial data pipelines
- Applied machine learning for imagery
